element.name: Nosferatu
element.source: Vampire the Masquerade: Bound by Blood

description.p: Hide Yourself from Prying Eyes and Unleash Your Own Monstrous Nature

Nosferatu undergo a tragic transformation upon becoming Kindred. Their visage is warped to represent the Beast inside, making them into a terror who forges connections only with vermin and monsters. They must overcome this adversity with their gifts, lest they become the monsters they resemble.

element.name: Level 3: Hidden in Plain Sight
element.source: Vampire the Masquerade: Bound by Blood

description.p: Mask of a Thousand Faces. You can cast the Disguise Self spell without expending a spell slot.
Vanish. You can cast the Invisibility spell without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and regain all expended uses when you finish a Short Rest or Long Rest.

element.name: Level 3: Nosferatu Bane
element.source: Vampire the Masquerade: Bound by Blood

description.p: Your physical appearance is monstrous and unsettling. You have Disadvantage on Charisma checks when interacting with non-Undead that can see your hideous visage.

sheet.description: You have Disadvantage on Charisma checks when interacting with non-Undead that can see your hideous visage.

element.name: Level 6: Monstrous Gift
element.source: Vampire the Masquerade: Bound by Blood

description.p: You have become more at peace with your monstrous appearance, unlocking aspects of yourself. You can choose two benefits from the following list.

Animalist. You can cast the Animal Friendship, Animal Messenger, and Speak with Animals spells. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot. Once you cast each spell in this way, you can't cast that spell in this way again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.
Ears of the Bat. You have Blindsight with a range of 60 feet.

Feral Talons. You have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed, and when you hit with your Unarmed Strike and deal damage, you can deal Slashing damage equal to 1d8 plus your Strength modifier instead of the normal damage of an Unarmed Strike.
Leathery Hide. Creatures you can see within 60 feet of yourself have Disadvantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Charmed condition.
Patagia. Creatures you can see within 60 feet of yourself have Disadvantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Charmed condition.
The Terror. Creatures you can see within 60 feet of yourself have Disadvantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

element.name: Patagia
element.source: Vampire the Masquerade: Bound by Blood

description.p: If you aren't Incapacitated or wearing Heavy armor, you can extend your skin to glide. When you fall, you can move up to 5 feet horizontally for every 1 foot you descend, and when you would take damage from a fall, you can take a Reaction to reduce the fall's damage to 0.

element.name: The Terror
element.source: Vampire the Masquerade: Bound by Blood

description.p: As a Magic action, you can reveal your monstrous nature to up to three creatures you can see within 30 feet. Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus your Charisma modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or gain the Frightened condition for 1 minute, or until you deal damage to it.

sheet.description: You can reveal your monstrous nature to up to three creatures you can see within 30 ft. Each target must succeed on a DC{{}} Wisdom save or gain the Frightened condition for 1 minute, or until you deal damage to it.

element.name: Level 9: Inhuman Strength
element.source: Vampire the Masquerade: Bound by Blood

description.p: You experience the world, in all its wonders, with vampiric speed. You gain the following benefits.
Ability Score Increase. Your Strength score increases by 2, to a maximum of 25.
Powerful Blows. As a Bonus Action, expend 3 Blood Points for 1 minute. When you hit with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, the target takes an extra 1d10 Force damage.

sheet.description: For 1 minute, when you hit with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, the target takes an extra 1d10 Force damage.

element.name: Level 11: The Concealing
element.source: Vampire the Masquerade: Bound by Blood

description.p: Your obfuscation abilities can now extend to objects and creatures in your vicinity.

Conceal. As a Magic action you can expend 3 Blood Points to touch an object and make it vanish from sight and memory. The object gains the Invisible condition and creatures forgetting it may recover memories by succeeding on the Investigation check described in the source. A Remove Curse or Greater Restoration restores true memory.
Cloak the Gathering. When you cast Invisibility, you can expend up to 6 Blood Points to affect additional creatures within 30 feet.

element.name: Level 15: Greater Monstrous Gift
element.source: Vampire the Masquerade: Bound by Blood

description.p: Your physical monstrousness has evolved. You can choose one benefit from the following list.
Call the Wretched. You can expend 2 Blood Points to cast the Blight or Insect Plague spell.

Distending Jaws. You can roll one additional Feed Die when you feed. In addition, you can use your jaws to make Unarmed Strikes. When you hit with your Unarmed Strike and deal damage, you can deal Piercing damage equal to 2d6 plus your Strength modifier instead of the normal damage of an Unarmed Strike.
One with the Night. Your Blindsight is increased to 90 feet, and you can see normally in Dim Light and Darkness—both magical and nonmagical—within 120 feet of yourself.
Skin of the Chameleon. You can expend 2 Blood Points to cast the Greater Invisibility spell. In addition, you have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

Stony Flesh. In response to taking damage, you can use your Reaction to expend 1 Blood Point to gain Resistance for 1 minute to two damage types, other than Fire, Psychic, and Radiant, including against the triggering damage.
Wings of the Gargoyle. While you aren't wearing Heavy armor, your Speed increases by 10 feet, and you gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed.
